essence: The ritual requires the practitioner to be accompanied by śakti.
A delightful and charming vessel should be prepared.
Ritual drinking and eating should be performed together with initiated companions.
The entire kula practitioner group should be in a very joyful state of mind.
The kula kuṇḍalinī should be contemplated as consciousness extending from the mūlādhāra to the tongue.
